item.name: 京站時尚廣場 Q Square

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

title.zh-TW: 消費享購物及停車優惠、累積點數換贈品
title.en: Shopping and parking perks, and points to exchange for gifts

text.zh-TW: 手機就是會員卡。 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Your phone becomes your membership card. From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」複製邀請碼並開啟下載連結。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to copy the invite code and open the download link.

steps.zh-TW: 安裝京站時尚廣場 App 並開始開通會員。
steps.en: Install the Qsquare app and start activating your membership.

intro.zh-TW: 下載京站時尚廣場 APP（京站行動Q卡）並開通會員，開通時輸入邀請碼 01389334，一起獲得好禮。
intro.en: Download the Qsquare app (mobile Q Card), activate your membership and enter invite code 01389334 to get a welcome gift.

description.zh-TW:
依分享文案，京站時尚廣場 Q Square 的 App（京站行動Q卡）讓手機成為會員卡，可享購物及停車優惠，並可累積點數換贈品。本站的連結為短網址，不帶邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」會複製邀請碼 01389334，並開啟下載連結。

安裝後，在開通會員時貼上邀請碼即可，也可手動輸入。開通送好禮等內容取自分享文案，實際贈品與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en:
According to the share text, the Qsquare app (mobile Q Card) turns your phone into a membership card, with shopping and parking perks and points to exchange for gifts. This site's link is a short link without the invite code. Selecting “Sign up” copies code 01389334 and opens the download link.

Install the app and paste the code, or type it in, when you activate your membership. The welcome gift and other perks come from the share text, so actual gifts, amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 此連結為短網址，不帶邀請碼，開通時需要貼上或手動輸入。贈品內容與期限以官方公告為準。
notes.en: This is a short link and does not include the code, so paste or enter it when activating. Gift details and deadlines follow the official announcements.
